skills.name: internet_search
skills.description: Search the public internet and return source links. Uses Brave Search when BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY is configured, otherwise Gemini grounded Search. Stable background questions can fall back to Wikipedia. Never treat Wikipedia background as verification of current news, prices, weather, or schedules.

query.description: Specific question or terms to search on the public web.

skills.name: read_url
skills.description: Fetch, read, and analyze the contents of any public web page or link (URL) directly in the background without opening a browser window. Returns clean page text and links for summarization, answering questions, or inspecting web content. Use this whenever the user sends a link or asks you to read, analyze, or summarize a URL.

url.description: The complete http:// or https:// URL to fetch and read.
